instruction: Please enable the minimal view mode in VLC. I prefer a cleaner interface without the menu bar when watching videos.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
